secondClone.status: no change needed — see decision.whyNotTheProxy and consumers rows 7-11

missionPremise: A-180 / the 2026-09-11 ruling ENVELOPE DRAWN, FIGURE REFUSED (canon preamble; `_decisions/2026-09-11_ruling_b_reversed_polygon_only.md`): the modelled buildable envelope may DRAW wherever a district and a setback table exist, but the buildable AREA and PERCENT stay refused until a ground-truth VERIFIED (depth-warm promoted) envelope atom backs them. The dispatch's finding (A-205, measured 2026-09-17) is that the route `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/brokeragePlaceBuildableEnvelope.ts` returns `payload.geojson.features[].properties.buildableAreaSqFt` / `buildableAreaPct` on every drawn envelope, and that `apps/property-explorer/api/spine.ts` allowlists that route for anonymous callers — so the refused figure reaches anyone through smartsite.cloud, while the panel (`figureWithheld`) and the MCP draw block (`derivedFigures.denies`) withhold it on their own. The route was the one surface that did not.

decision.whereWithheld: AT THE SOURCE, in legacy-design-tools, in the pure composition `artifacts/api-server/src/lib/buildableEnvelope/composeBuildableEnvelopeDerivation.ts` — a new last step `withholdUnverifiedAreaFigure(reconciled, atomPromotion)` (implemented in `reconcileAtomEnvelope.ts`, which already owns the verification predicate). The two properties are DELETED from the feature properties whenever `isEnvelopeAtomVerified` is false; geometry, disclosure and everything else are untouched.
decision.predicate: The SAME predicate P-249 uses, one definition, imported not copied: `isEnvelopeAtomVerified` (reconcileAtomEnvelope.ts:67) — `depthWarmPromotion === "depth-warm-promoted-v1"` (DEPTH_WARM_PROMOTION_MARKER), else the documented `sourceCitation` fallback containing `depth-warm-verified`, absent fields read as unverified. The verification predicate itself is NOT changed (dispatch 'Do not').
decision.withholdingIs: ABSENCE, not zero and not a substitute. (a) The keys are deleted, so a consumer reads `undefined` — the state the PE wire mapper (`?? null`), the map card's `num()` and live-envelope-augment's atom-area read already treat as 'no figure available'. (b) A zero would be a DIFFERENT false claim (a measured 'setbacks consume the lot'), so a withheld figure never becomes 0. (c) The atom's own unverified number is still not quoted (P-249's stance) and is not re-derived on the way out — no substitute figure, so no new unfounded number. (d) The `disclosure` string is replaced with an explicit withholding sentence (AREA_FIGURE_WITHHELD_DISCLOSURE) so a reader is told WHY the figure is missing instead of being left to guess; on an empty result the decline's own words are kept (different fact). (e) Idempotent — re-running on an already-withheld payload is a no-op.
decision.whyNotTheProxy: 1) The dispatch prefers the option that 'also protects authenticated callers that are not supposed to print the figure', and a strip in `apps/property-explorer/api/spine.ts` governs ONLY the anonymous browse path — an authenticated service-token / cortex-proxy POST would still be served the refused figure. 2) The composition is the single choke point the route AND the MCP draw-block orchestration (`parcelDrawEnvelopeModel.ts`, P-153 Step A) both call, so one edit cannot drift between the two surfaces; striping the proxy would fix exactly one of the consumers in the list below. 3) It keeps the refusal next to the only thing that can evaluate the predicate (the atom's own promotion fields, already fetched and passed into the composition). 4) Code-done honesty: hauska-map's proxy is a passthrough allowlist, not a data-shaping layer; teaching it to editorialize on a cortex payload would add a second, divergent copy of an entitlement rule in another repo (the exact duplication class P-249 avoided by sharing the predicate).
decision.noChangeIn: hauska-map. Its facets producer already gates the figure on `depthWarm` (apps/property-explorer/api/_lib/atom-chain-to-facets.ts:2178-2180) and already withholds it on the unverified no-buildable-area branch (`figureWithheld: true`, :2117-2129); its live-envelope augment is already P-249-guarded (`if (...) && !figureWithheld`), and it reads the live figure out of THIS route's response, so the source change removes the figure from under it automatically rather than needing a second edit. Detail per row in `consumers`.

outOfScopeNamed: hauska-engine's own buildable-area figure / site-plan PDF entitlement (P-261) — different repo, different seat.
The 2026-09-15 PE facets `figureWithheld` behaviour itself (P-249) — consumed here, not changed.

The `maxFootprintSqFt` field — the SAME withheld number under a third name, and the one residual channel this lane did NOT close. Live: the unverified Hays probe returns maxFootprintSqFt 5022 alongside the withheld 5022, and derive.ts:286-292 shows why (`maxFootprintSqFt = round(min(buildableAreaSqFt, coverageCap))`, i.e. it is the modelled buildable area whenever the modelled envelope, not lot coverage, is the binding constraint). It is NOT one of the two fields the dispatch names, and it is NOT purely a modelled figure: when `maxLotCoveragePct` binds, the value falls out of two authoritative numbers alone (codified coverage cap x measured lot area) and is legitimately printable. Which of the two regimes a given parcel is in is an entitlement RULING (an operator stop point), so this lane implements the dispatched two-field predicate exactly, pins it with tests, and reports this as a finding with the numbers and a one-line remedy for the integration seat/planner rather than widening the change unilaterally.
